dialogue.t: I don't know whether I'm coming or going anymore...
No worries, I'm just trying to sort out everything that needs to be taken care of for the Lantern Rite.
It's just that... The more I think about it, the more issues come up...

Even though my colleagues took parts of the workload upon themselves, it's my turn this year to coordinate the Xiao Lantern delivery. If I don't buck up and prepare everything, I won't make it in time...

dialogue.sit: How many people do you have to send them out to?

dialogue.t: Right... When I said "Xiao Lantern delivery," I meant more than just sending out the lanterns themselves.
Simply put... It's more about playing the role of the Lantern Rite ambassador, passing on well-wishes, and creating the festive atmosphere...
Even with most people being off work for the festival, including some store owners and their staff...
There are still essential workers who can't just take a break — for example, those in charge of keeping order during the celebration, like the Millelith.
The Ministry of Civil Affairs usually sends them gifts to acknowledge their hard work around the Lantern Rite season...
I was about to visit the Millelith responsible for keeping our city safe to gift them Xiao Lanterns as a token of gratitude.
However... We're a little bit short-staffed and haven't managed to send out the gifts to all the soldiers on our list yet...
Could you do me a favor and deliver these gifts?
Really? That's amazing! Thank you so much.
Let me see... Which of the Millelith haven't been checked off...
Xiangming... Hongyi... and Cai Le.
I'll mark their stations for you. I can't thank you enough.
Hmm? Do you need anything? I'm on duty...
Quiet down a bit, I'm working over here! What do you mean, gift delivery?
Oh, it's from the Ministry of Civil Affairs? I see...
Another year, another Lantern Rite. And I'd wanted to head home earlier this year, too...
But given the current situation, I can't relax just yet... I guess I'll be heading home a few hours late again...
Thanks for coming all this way. I'll take this. Thanks!
*sigh* When's that fellow going to leave...
That's strange... Cai Xun's gift has been delivered, but Cai Le's hasn't...
Eh, someone on the gift delivery duty must've had a slip-up...
What's wrong with the well...
Huh, this must be from the Ministry of Civil Affairs. Thank you, I'll take it.
Still, I need to remain on duty for a while more to ensure that no residents come to draw water from the well.
*sigh* Who knows what's wrong with it... But either way, it can't be drunk from now...
*sobs* I—I haven't finished writing my wish...
Be a good girl, Little Xian. That nice uncle from the Millelith went to fetch it for you.
Are you looking for that nice Millelith?
Little Xian was writing her wish on a Xiao Lantern when she suddenly lost her grip on it, and the Lantern flew away that way...
That Millelith told us he'd seen it hanging on a tree and went to get it for us.

dialogue.sit: What's so special about that Xiao Lantern?

dialogue.t: I told her we could make another one, but she...
Uh... No... We can't. My brother worked so hard to make that lantern...
Little Xian, that nice uncle will bring it back to us in no time...
My apologies. If you really need to talk to that Millelith, you can find him over there.
For Archon's sake... How do I get there? Perhaps I should try something different...
Traveler? Haha, it's nothing. I'm just wondering how to climb up that tree and retrieve that Xiao Lantern.
It's so hard to fight gravity in full armor... I just slip back down each time...
Eh... Would you mind lending me a helping hand? Recovering that Xiao Lantern shouldn't be too difficult for you.
Great, many thanks. Let's get it done as quickly as we can so the little girl can finally cheer up.
I... *sobs* I haven't finished writing my wish. What if it doesn't come true...
It will. I'm sure it will, but only if you behave like a good girl, Little Xian...
Luckily, that Xiao Lantern got stuck on a tree. If it'd flown any higher, we wouldn't be able to reach it...
Did you get the Xiao Lantern?
Let me take a look... Yeah, that's the one. You just made those kids' day. I'll give it back to them.
I hope they are still waiting where I left them...
This must be from the Ministry of Civil Affairs. Alright, gratefully received. Thanks for the trouble.

dialogue.sit: Was it also your duty as a member of the Millelith?

dialogue.t: Do you mean retrieving lost Xiao Lanterns? Hahahah, of course.
Doesn't matter if it's finding Xiao Lanterns, chasing after evil-doers, or defeating monsters...
The Millelith's duty is to help those in need.
Thank you once again. I need to hurry up and give it back to those kids.
And then I still have other tasks to complete...
You're back! How did the gift delivery go?
You're a real life-saver... I wouldn't have made it without you.

dialogue.sit: Do they have to stay on duty throughout the whole festival?

dialogue.t: Well... The Ministry of Civil Affairs will schedule alternating shifts for them...
But Liyue is too large. There are too many stations and places that need patrolling.
We simply don't have enough recruits. Even though they take turns, some of them will get the shorter end of the stick and work during the Lantern Rite.
Besides, considering how grand the Lantern Rite celebrations are each year, some parts of the city require additional resources. No matter how we distribute our people, there's never enough manpower.

dialogue.sit: Sounds like a tall order indeed...

dialogue.t: Well, that's our job... We'll do what we can to ensure that everyone has a nice Lantern Rite.
Which reminds me of other people who might need help around the festival time. It'd be nice if you could lend them a hand.
The more people we encourage to participate in the Lantern Rite, the more festive its atmosphere will get.
We send Xiao Lanterns because we'd like for everyone to be able to release one and make their own wishes.
On a broader scale... we'd like the Lantern Rite to spread far and wide. It'd be great if everyone could experience its atmosphere.
Lantern Rite is meant for everyone, after all.
Alright, duty calls. I hope you have a great time during the Lantern Rite!
